scene.label: Act 4, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. London. Another Room in the Palace
scene.location: London. Another Room in the Palace

lines.text: The tyrannous and bloody act is done,
lines.plainText: The tyrannous and bloody act is done

lines.text: The most arch deed of piteous massacre
lines.plainText: The most arch deed of piteous massacre

lines.text: That ever yet this land was guilty of.
lines.plainText: That ever yet this land was guilty of

lines.text: Dighton and Forrest, who I did suborn
lines.plainText: Dighton and Forrest who I did suborn

lines.text: To do this piece of ruthless butchery,
lines.plainText: To do this piece of ruthless butchery

lines.text: Albeit they were fleshed villains, bloody dogs,
lines.plainText: Albeit they were fleshed villains bloody dogs

lines.text: Melted with tenderness and mild compassion,
lines.plainText: Melted with tenderness and mild compassion

lines.text: Wept like two children in their deaths' sad story.
lines.plainText: Wept like two children in their deaths' sad story

lines.text: "O, thus," quoth Dighton, "lay the gentle babes;"
lines.plainText: O thus quoth Dighton lay the gentle babes

lines.text: "Thus, thus," quoth Forrest, "girdling one another
lines.plainText: Thus thus quoth Forrest girdling one another

lines.text: Within their alabaster innocent arms.
lines.plainText: Within their alabaster innocent arms

lines.text: Their lips were four red roses on a stalk,
lines.plainText: Their lips were four red roses on a stalk

lines.text: And in their summer beauty kissed each other.
lines.plainText: And in their summer beauty kissed each other

lines.text: A book of prayers on their pillow lay,
lines.plainText: A book of prayers on their pillow lay

lines.text: Which once," quoth Forrest, "almost changed my mind.
lines.plainText: Which once quoth Forrest almost changed my mind

lines.text: But, O, the devil—" There the villain stopped;
lines.plainText: But O the devil There the villain stopped

lines.text: When Dighton thus told on: "We smothered
lines.plainText: When Dighton thus told on We smothered

lines.text: The most replenished sweet work of nature
lines.plainText: The most replenished sweet work of nature

lines.text: That from the prime creation e'er she framed."
lines.plainText: That from the prime creation e'er she framed

lines.text: Hence both are gone with conscience and remorse
lines.plainText: Hence both are gone with conscience and remorse

lines.text: They could not speak; and so I left them both
lines.plainText: They could not speak and so I left them both

lines.text: To bear this tidings to the bloody King.
lines.plainText: To bear this tidings to the bloody King

lines.text: Kind Tyrrel, am I happy in thy news?
lines.plainText: Kind Tyrrel am I happy in thy news

lines.text: If to have done the thing you gave in charge
lines.plainText: If to have done the thing you gave in charge

lines.text: Beget your happiness, be happy then,
lines.plainText: Beget your happiness be happy then

lines.text: For it is done.
lines.plainText: For it is done

lines.text: But didst thou see them dead?
lines.plainText: But didst thou see them dead

lines.text: I did, my lord.
lines.plainText: I did my lord

lines.text: And buried, gentle Tyrrel?
lines.plainText: And buried gentle Tyrrel

lines.text: The chaplain of the Tower hath buried them,
lines.plainText: The chaplain of the Tower hath buried them

lines.text: But where, to say the truth, I do not know.
lines.plainText: But where to say the truth I do not know

lines.text: Come to me, Tyrrel, soon, at after-supper,
lines.plainText: Come to me Tyrrel soon at aftersupper

lines.text: When thou shalt tell the process of their death.
lines.plainText: When thou shalt tell the process of their death

lines.text: Meantime, but think how I may do thee good,
lines.plainText: Meantime but think how I may do thee good

lines.text: And be inheritor of thy desire.
lines.plainText: And be inheritor of thy desire

lines.text: Farewell till then.
lines.plainText: Farewell till then

lines.text: I humbly take my leave.
lines.plainText: I humbly take my leave

lines.text: The son of Clarence have I pent up close;
lines.plainText: The son of Clarence have I pent up close

lines.text: His daughter meanly have I matched in marriage;
lines.plainText: His daughter meanly have I matched in marriage

lines.text: The sons of Edward sleep in Abraham's bosom,
lines.plainText: The sons of Edward sleep in Abraham's bosom

lines.text: And Anne my wife hath bid the world good night.
lines.plainText: And Anne my wife hath bid the world good night

lines.text: Now, for I know the Breton Richmond aims
lines.plainText: Now for I know the Breton Richmond aims

lines.text: At young Elizabeth, my brother's daughter,
lines.plainText: At young Elizabeth my brother's daughter

lines.text: And by that knot looks proudly on the crown,
lines.plainText: And by that knot looks proudly on the crown

lines.text: To her go I, a jolly thriving wooer.
lines.plainText: To her go I a jolly thriving wooer

lines.text: My lord!
lines.plainText: My lord

lines.text: Good or bad news, that thou com'st in so bluntly?
lines.plainText: Good or bad news that thou com'st in so bluntly

lines.text: Bad news, my lord. Morton is fled to Richmond,
lines.plainText: Bad news my lord Morton is fled to Richmond

lines.text: And Buckingham, backed with the hardy Welshmen,
lines.plainText: And Buckingham backed with the hardy Welshmen

lines.text: Is in the field, and still his power increaseth.
lines.plainText: Is in the field and still his power increaseth

lines.text: Ely with Richmond troubles me more near
lines.plainText: Ely with Richmond troubles me more near

lines.text: Than Buckingham and his rash-levied strength.
lines.plainText: Than Buckingham and his rashlevied strength

lines.text: Come, I have learned that fearful commenting
lines.plainText: Come I have learned that fearful commenting

lines.text: Is leaden servitor to dull delay;
lines.plainText: Is leaden servitor to dull delay

lines.text: Delay leads impotent and snail-paced beggary;
lines.plainText: Delay leads impotent and snailpaced beggary

lines.text: Then fiery expedition be my wing,
lines.plainText: Then fiery expedition be my wing

lines.text: Jove's Mercury, and herald for a king!
lines.plainText: Jove's Mercury and herald for a king

lines.text: Go, muster men. My counsel is my shield.
lines.plainText: Go muster men My counsel is my shield

lines.text: We must be brief when traitors brave the field.
lines.plainText: We must be brief when traitors brave the field
